query: Across Type of Traveller and Class, which review themes are associated with higher vs. lower Overall Rating?

per_column.name: crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Well-separated, interpretable categories (attentive_warm, inattentive_robotic, professional_neutral, rude_hostile) that capture a review theme distinct from the numeric focus and can be segmented against Overall Rating.

per_column.name: service_consistency
per_column.rationale: Clean three-way split (consistent_high, consistently_poor, variable_mixed) offers an interpretable associational dimension for comparing ratings.

per_column.name: food_quality
per_column.rationale: Ordered, interpretable categories (excellent/acceptable/poor_bland) with reasonable spread; nulls present but categories remain comparable against the focus.

per_column.name: special_meal_fulfillment
per_column.rationale: Boolean is extremely imbalanced (17 true vs 883 false), making it near-constant; too few positive cases to draw a meaningful comparison with Overall Rating.

per_column.name: seat_comfort_condition
per_column.rationale: Distinct, interpretable comfort categories that map to a review theme and can be segmented, though heavy nulls weaken coverage.

per_column.name: cabin_class_expectation_gap
per_column.rationale: Interpretable expectation-gap tiers that are especially aligned with the query's Class dimension and support informative rating comparisons.

per_column.name: service_amenity_cuts
per_column.rationale: Highly imbalanced boolean (79 true vs 821 false); limited but not trivial, yet the near-constant distribution restricts segmentation power.

per_column.name: service_decline_perception
per_column.rationale: Boolean with 106 true cases; interpretable theme with enough minority mass to compare rating distributions, though imbalance limits it.

per_column.name: value_for_money_perception
per_column.rationale: Categories are interpretable, but this largely restates the existing 'Value For Money' column and correlates tightly with Overall Rating, adding little external associational information.

judge.rationale: As a set, most added columns provide interpretable, well-separated categorical themes (crew service, consistency, food, seat condition, expectation gap) that segment cleanly and support discovering informative relationships with Overall Rating, directly serving the query's theme-vs-rating exploration. Weaknesses lower the score: two booleans (special_meal_fulfillment, service_amenity_cuts) are so imbalanced they enable little comparison, and value_for_money_perception essentially restates an existing column highly collinear with the focus. Overall the set is genuinely EDA-oriented rather than opaque feature engineering, but redundancy and near-constant booleans keep it from being fully informative.
